event_text: The Bandaranaike Airport attack is carried out by 14 Tamil Tiger commandos, resulting in military and civilian casualties and destroyed aircraft.
story: As Barry and Susan pecked at crumbs on the tarmac, explosions rocked the Bandaranaike Airport, sending them into a frantic flutter. On July 24, 2001, the Tamil Tigers launched a daring raid, with 14 commandos storming the airport, leaving a trail of destruction and death in their wake. The pigeons dodged falling debris as aircraft erupted in flames, the screams of the wounded and dying filling the air. Barry and Susan took to the skies, fleeing the carnage as the Tigers destroyed military and civilian planes, dealing a devastating blow to the Sri Lankan economy and claiming countless lives.
